content.short: Clipper is a DEX optimized for retail traders and small LPs, offering the best swap rates for trades under $10K on blue-chip assets like ETH, WBTC, and stablecoins.
content.description: Clipper is a decentralized exchange built specifically for retail-sized trades and smaller liquidity providers, using a Formula Market Maker (FMM) model that outperforms other DEXes for trades under $10,000 with tighter spreads on blue-chip assets. Clipper also provides favorable returns for LPs by minimizing impermanent loss through its unique pricing mechanism. Deployed on Mantle, Clipper democratizes access to tight spreads that were previously only available to large traders on centralized exchanges.
